frame.load_path: metal parts -> metal brackets/bearing plates -> short-span 2020 -> table

housing.scope: external enclosure and non-hot printed parts; functional parts require retained fit/load checks

fastener_stock.profile_preference: matching 2020 slot/T-nut, normally M5 or M6 subject to actual profile
fastener_stock.critical_joint_rule: retain specified grade, engagement and load path; stock diameter alone is insufficient

donor_printer.relationship_to_previous_bed_fault_repor: Latest statement governs this asset; identity with earlier printer not assumed

cnc_policy: standard stock/donor -> saw/drill/bend/cut-sheet -> local turning/ream/keyway -> special CNC only where functional geometry requires
price_policy: cost and effort prioritized; no reinstated hard 200000 KRW release cap
